name: inputs-ledger-column-holds-across-presets
description: The shortcut ledger's key column starts at the same x under the Arc preset and under the Atrium preset. The column is sized max-content, so under a preset with only narrow chords it used to collapse against the icon buttons, and the keys of every row jumped right. A fixed width keeps it a column, and a row with two chords wraps inside it. Same launch and preset-switch steps as inputs-pane-switches-hotkey-presets.

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="inputs"]'); if (!item) { return 'no inputs rail item'; } item.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { const btn = document.querySelector('.hotkey-preset[data-preset="arc"]'); if (!btn) { return 'no arc button'; } btn.click(); const ok = document.querySelector('.hotkey-preset-confirm'); if (ok) { ok.click(); } return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { const on = (document.querySelector('.hotkey-preset.on') || {dataset: {}}).dataset.preset; const v = document.querySelector('.hotkey-ledger > .settings-row[data-action] .settings-row-value'); const a = document.querySelector('.hotkey-ledger > .settings-row[data-action] .hotkey-actions'); if (!v || !a) { return 'no row'; } window.__colArc = Math.round(v.getBoundingClientRect().left); return on + ':' + (a.getBoundingClientRect().left - window.__colArc >= 200 ? 'column' : 'collapsed'); })()

(() => { const btn = document.querySelector('.hotkey-preset[data-preset="atrium"]'); if (!btn) { return 'no atrium button'; } btn.click(); const ok = document.querySelector('.hotkey-preset-confirm'); if (ok) { ok.click(); } return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { const on = (document.querySelector('.hotkey-preset.on') || {dataset: {}}).dataset.preset; const v = document.querySelector('.hotkey-ledger > .settings-row[data-action] .settings-row-value'); if (!v) { return 'no row'; } const l = Math.round(v.getBoundingClientRect().left); return on + ':' + (l === window.__colArc ? 'same' : 'moved ' + window.__colArc + ' -> ' + l); })()

assertions.desc: gates the measurement: the Inputs pane opened
gates the measurement: the Arc preset was picked and confirmed
under Arc, where no chord is wide, the keys still sit in a column at least 200px left of the buttons
gates the measurement: the Atrium preset was picked and confirmed
THE MEASUREMENT: the key column starts at the same x under both presets
the settings window closed on cmd+w, the browser window remains
